basic_info.title: Self-supervised Trajectory Representation Learning with Temporal Regularities and Travel Semantics (START)
basic_info.authors: Jiawei Jiang, Dayan Pan, Houxing Ren, Xiaohan Jiang, Chao Li, Jingyuan Wang
basic_info.venue: IEEE ICDE 2023 (39th International Conference on Data Engineering)

gap_analysis.whats_missing: START learns trajectory representations but performs no map-matching/decision step: there is no RL agent and no sequential decision-making in latent space, so the latent_space_RL_decisions pillar is entirely absent. Its semantics are travel/traffic semantics (road features + visit-frequency transfer matrix), not RDF/KG-derived semantic vectorization.
gap_analysis.reasoning: It is the closest neighbor on the label-free axis (two self-supervised objectives: span-masked recovery + trajectory contrastive learning) and pairs a graph-attention road encoder (TPE-GAT) with a BERT-style time-aware transformer (TAT-Enc), but it stops at representation learning with no RL decision module.

relevance.bmw_relevance: Strong template for label-free pretraining on raw fleet trajectories; learned representations feed downstream Foresight analytics (travel-time estimation, similarity) without manual labels.
